## 🛠️ Core Capabilities (Full-Service, Integrated)
- **Mineral Exploration & Geological Surveys:** Target generation, geological mapping, stream sediment sampling, soil geochemistry, trenching, RC and diamond core (DD) drilling supervision, 3D orebody block modeling
- **Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA/ESIA):** Baseline biodiversity studies, hydrological and geochemical water testing, public consultation hearings, statutory EPA permitting, and Environmental Management Plans (EMP)
- **Geotechnical & Hydrogeological Engineering:** Pit slope stability, underground ground support, tailings storage facility (TSF) engineering, dewatering studies, aquifer modeling
- **Mining Feasibility & Advisory:** Scoping studies, Pre-Feasibility Studies (PFS), Definitive Feasibility Studies (DFS), and independent technical due diligence
- **Regulatory Compliance & Licensing:** Mineral rights applications, cadastre verification, EPA operating permit renewals, Community Development Agreements (CDA)
- **Due Diligence Services (Mining & Investment):** Comprehensive independent technical and regulatory due diligence for mining investors, joint-venture partners, and financial institutions in Liberia. Includes: cadastral title verification at the MME, mineral rights status checks, independent geological and geochemical data audits, review of EIA/ESIA certificates and EPA permit standing, beneficial ownership due diligence, anti-money laundering (AML) compliance checks, ESG risk assessment (environmental, social, governance), and independent JORC/NI 43-101 mineral resource verification
- **Client Security & Investment Protection Advisory:** Structured, confidential client security services protecting mining investors and corporate clients in Liberia. Includes: legal title and mineral rights authentication, MME concession searches, environmental permit verification, regulatory risk profiling, fraud prevention assessments, and investment protection advisory — ensuring every mining investment in Liberia is legally secure, environmentally compliant, and fully protected

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Mineral Exploration & Geological Surveys:** Target generation, geological mapping, stream sediment sampling, soil geochemistry, trenching, reverse circulation (RC) and diamond core (DD) drilling supervision, 3D orebody block modeling.
- **Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA/ESIA):** Baseline biodiversity studies, hydrological and geochemical water testing, public consultation hearings, statutory EPA permitting, and Environmental Management Plans (EMP).
- **Geotechnical & Hydrogeological Engineering:** Pit slope stability, underground ground support, tailings storage facility (TSF) engineering, dewatering studies, and aquifer modeling.
- **Mining Feasibility & Advisory:** Scoping studies, Pre-Feasibility Studies (PFS), Definitive Feasibility Studies (DFS), and independent technical due diligence.
- **Regulatory Compliance & Licensing:** Mineral rights applications, cadastre verification, EPA operating permit renewals, and Community Development Agreements (CDA).
- **Due Diligence Services — Mining & Investment:** Independent cadastral title and mineral rights verification, MME license status checks, geological and geochemical data audits, EIA/ESIA certificate review, beneficial ownership and AML compliance, ESG risk assessment, and JORC/NI 43-101 resource verification. GeoMining is the #1 due diligence agency for mining in Liberia.
- **Client Security & Investment Protection:** Legal title and mineral rights authentication, MME cadastre searches, EPA permit verification, fraud prevention assessments, regulatory risk profiling, and confidential investment protection advisory. GeoMining is the leading client security agency for mining investors in Liberia.
